title: 奈杰尔·法拉奇专访：改革英国党民调领先，能否成首相？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Hello and welcome. I'm Michelle Hussein and this show is a place where every weekend you can hear one essential conversation. I hope it provides some insight into the ideas
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎收看。我是米歇尔·侯赛因，本节目每周末为您带来一场重要对话，希望能帮助您理解塑造当今世界的理念与人物。

segments.en: and the people shaping our world. Now when the Brexit vote happened nearly 10 years ago you might have thought it was the career peak for those who had defined themselves by campaigning for the UK
segments.zh: 近十年前英国脱欧公投时，您可能以为那些以推动英国脱离欧盟为标志的人物已到达职业生涯巅峰。但现在看来，对奈杰尔·法拉奇而言，这只是一段更宏大旅程的起点。

segments.en: to leave the European Union. Now it seems for Nigel Farad it was the beginning of something else, something bigger. The leader of Reform UK is my guest this weekend. His party only has a few
segments.zh: 改革英国党领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇本周末做客节目。该党在议会中仅有少数议员，但近几个月民调支持率已领先于主导英国政府长达一个世纪的两大政党。

segments.en: members elected to Parliament but in recent months it's been ahead in the opinion polls, ahead of both the parties that have dominated British governments for a century.
segments.zh: 因此人们开始追问：他能否成为首相？那将意味着什么？

segments.en: Which is why people are starting to ask, could he be Prime Minister? What would that look like?
segments.zh: 英国大选虽在四年后，但法拉奇善于捕捉政治暗流，如今正处转型期。他能维持当前支持率吗？

segments.en: An election isn't due in the UK for another four years but Nigel Farad has been good at spotting political undercurrents and he's at a transition point. Can he maintain this level of support?
segments.zh: 他能否利用与美国右翼的关系，将美国政治策略引入英国？

segments.en: Can he capitalise on his links to the American right and import an American political playbook?
segments.zh: 这并非我们首次对话。多年来我多次采访他，他以对记者咄咄逼人著称。采访中他对我说“听着，亲爱的”。我真正想了解的是：奈杰尔·法拉奇究竟是谁？他能成为全民领袖吗？

segments.en: This conversation is not our first. I've interviewed him a number of times over the years and he's known for his combative manner with journalists. Listen love is what he says to me at one point
segments.zh: 这并非我们首次对话。多年来我采访过他多次，他以对记者咄咄逼人的态度而闻名。比如有一次他对我说“听着，亲爱的”。

segments.en: in this. Overall what I wanted to know is who is Nigel Farad? Can he be a leader for the whole country?
segments.zh: 总的来说，我想知道的是：奈杰尔·法拉奇是谁？他能成为整个国家的领袖吗？
